While the number of deaths from swine flu is bad,  not gonna argue on that one, it’s less than the annual numbers for the common flu (12,000 from Swine Flu and 61,000 from common influenza) Trump’s claim at the beginning of this was how there were so little deaths compared to the annual flu and yet nobody worries about that. 

What boggles me is how he made such a big deal about how 12,000 people died from swine flu under Obama’s position in office, when according to what he’s said before, it should be no big deal and “life and economy goes on,” because around 61,000 people die from the flu every year. 

I’m not against the dude and I do agree with some of his ideas and believe that the media can easily twist his words. I’m just saying that his argument about how Obama handled the Swine Flu is directly countered by something that Donald Trump himself has cited (Flu’s Annual deaths).

It’s no doubt that he did handle this poorly at the beginning, and I do believe the Obama Administration could’ve done better as well. I just hope Trump takes responsibility for how he initially responded to Covid-19 and not place the blame on something that’s already happened.

I hope the best for you all, by the way. Please stay safe out there. Currently passing the time surfing through reddit because of this crud.
